summary: Retire all public EKODI Pay subdomain entry points and make https://ekodi.kr/ekodipay/ the sole user-facing EKODI payment entry.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly requested that EKODI no longer use pay.ekodi.kr or other public payment subdomains, that they be private, and that EKODI Pay be built beneath ekodi.kr/ekodipay with EKODI coordination.
implementation: Remove retired payment hostname entries from constitution public legacy-domain allowlist and canonical-host mappings.
Add /ekodipay canonical platform route and isolated path-scoped Worker on the ekodi.kr apex zone.
Update service manifest, admin menus, authentication return paths, business checkout intent and Finance monitoring to the single canonical payment path.
Retain protected fail-closed money movement and require contracted PG, server-side verification, guarded production rollout and explicit financial approval before enabling real charges.
Retire legacy public ingress safely with 410/noindex/no-store; do not create payment-subdomain redirects.
mandatoryRules: Public payment entry is https://ekodi.kr/ekodipay/ only.
Do not reinstate a public payment subdomain without owner-approved constitution change.
No card data, payment secrets or unverified payment-success claims may reach browser code.
Production money movement remains disabled until financial-owner approval and PCI/PG readiness checks.
CI, security, zero-subdomain guard, protected merge, rollback, operational and PC/mobile validation remain mandatory.
validation: production canonical route and retired host responses
rollback: Restore the prior internal worker version and disable newly introduced payment entry if issues arise; never restore retired public payment-subdomain access without a newly approved policy change.
